dogecoin.text:
@_dogegod_ Right now, Bitcoin is 30% above its all-time high, while Dogecoin is still 70% below its own ATH.

What do you think?

@_dogegod_ I support Dogecoin, but Dogecoin doesn't support me. When Bitcoin drops by 0.5%, Dogecoin drops by 5%. Interestingly, when Bitcoin rises by 5%, Dogecoin only goes up by 0.5%. It seems like Dogecoin only aligns with Bitcoin when it comes to going down.
